summary.intent: Apply review fixes to PR #236 (workspace discovery hardening) in the callisto repo, commit and push them, then rebase the already-committed PR 3 onto them as a stacked PR and start the write-preflight PR.
summary.outcome: PR 3 was committed locally and the #236 review fixes (specs, E312 .gitignore escape hatch, E311 on non-mapping YAML/JSON roots, test cleanup, changesets) were applied, passed `just ci` (exit 0, 92.69% coverage), and were committed and pushed to fix/discovery-total. Rebasing PR 3, opening it stacked, and the write-preflight PR remain.

repo: `just ci` is the full gate (fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests, coverage); coverage is read from the TOTAL line of its log (currently 92.69%).
Work is done in git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ (e.g. discovery-total); the branch for #236 is fix/discovery-total.
Each PR change needs changeset files in .changeset, organized one per topic.
Workspace discovery behavior is specified in docs/specs/workspace.json (WS-DISC-xx entries); specs must be kept in sync with behavior, and errors are documented in docs/errors.md (E311, E312).
The ignore walker (crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/ignore_walk.rs) honors a .gitignore under the workspace root even when the Git toplevel is above it; this is the E312 escape hatch.
Root detection does not parse pnpm-workspace.yaml or pyproject.toml, so WS-DISC-12 must not claim it does.
The Cargo resolver doesn't need to strip a BOM itself; the BOM tests were vacuous and the strip was redundant.

code.finding: Walker setup/gitignore handling that was inspected to implement the .gitignore escape hatch under the workspace root.
Cargo manifest parsing contained a redundant strip_prefix of U+FEFF before toml_edit parse; removed.

workflow: Multi-step scripted edits via a Python helper script failed midway on a formatting mismatch with earlier edits already applied; the fix was to derive a trimmed second script containing only the unapplied steps rather than rerunning.
Long-running `just ci` was run in the background with output to a log file and the result checked via task notification, then grepped for exit code and coverage.
Python run with -I and scratch scripts kept in a scratchpad dir outside the repo; commit messages written to files and passed via `git commit -F`.
Verified upstream PR #235 checks were all green via `gh pr checks` before pushing stacked work.

friction: The Python edit script stopped partway at a text mismatch (BOM strip block formatting), leaving partial edits applied and requiring a manual recovery script.
Path confusion between worktrees (task output lived under a different worktree directory than the scratchpad) required care when reading results.
open_items: Rebase PR 3 onto the pushed #236 fixes, push, and open it stacked.
Globs like `./packages/*` and `packages/*/` still silently match nothing (follow-up PR).
Workspace-root check ignores inline and dotted `[workspace]` tables (follow-up PR).
A template Cargo.toml at an ancestor now stops every command; this follows from the chosen policy and should be noted in the PR description.
